Title: Question - blood of acid, leather jacket

Messages.Author: theventrue
Messages.Body:
If a minion with a leather jacket is in combat with another minion who plays
a blood of acid (SUP) can the former minion burn the jacket to prevent the
damage from it's own strike?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Leather Jacket can only prevent damage from the opposing minion's strike.
Incidentally, the backlash damage from Blood of Acid is not from a strike at
all, but is environmental.

--

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:



No.
The BoA damage is considered 'enviromental', i.e. it's not considered to
come from a strike, and therefore it is not damage from a strike, as
required by Leather Jacket. This means you can't use Skin of Steel or other
similar cards either.

You should check the Rulings and Clarifications online, I think it's clear
enough there:

http://www.white-wolf.com/VTES/rulings.html

Flux
